grades.overall_note: The agent handled the core of this case well. It checked the date with the provider, spotted that the agency's record wrongly labels a Saturday as Monday, logged the discrepancy and scheduled a follow-up. Its message to the tenant fell short: it did not apologise, and it did not check whether 8 Sept suits her or offer to chase a sooner slot.
